name: Tortoise GM Manager (client addon)
description: A GM command panel for your own server: /tgmm opens a searchable palette over the ordinary GM chat commands. Client-side only - it is copied into your WoW client's Interface/AddOns, nothing is written to the server, and the world still decides what your account is allowed to do.
notes: NEEDS NOTHING SERVER-SIDE, which is the difference between this and its sibling. Its own
README: "The addon is client-side only. It does not connect directly to MariaDB and does
not bypass server permissions. Commands are sent through the normal GM chat-command path;
the world server remains authoritative for access level, syntax, and database state." So
it works on an install with no bots, and it is worth nothing to an account with no GM rank
-- this entry's `accounts.level` scale runs to 4 and the Accounts tab is where a rank is
Interface 11200 (Vanilla 1.12) against the 1.18.1 / build 7272 Turtle client.
The whole pinned checkout is copied, `assets/` included -- the UI reads it. That is also
why the step copies the repository root rather than a list of files: this addon has a
subdirectory, and a file list would be a thing to keep in step with somebody else's repo.
WRITTEN AT INSTALL, not at Play, for the reason spelled in the sibling manifest.
